pages.text: $(bold)Boundary Fragment$()$(br2)Shards stripped from Domain Boundary blocks when a domain is $(bold)destroyed$() (each boundary block has a $(bold)1/100$() chance to drop one; stack size 60).$(br2)Uses:$(li)whenever you spend cursed energy (techniques / domains), $(bold)Boundary Fragments in your inventory are consumed first$() — $(bold)1 fragment = 25 Cursed Energy$()$(li)any shortfall is then deducted from your Cursed Energy / Soul Energy in the normal order
